title: Coxeter and Schubert combinatorics of $μ$-Involutions
summary: The variety of complete quadrics is the wonderful compactification of $GL_n/O_n$ and admits a cell decomposition into Borel orbits indexed by combinatorial objects called $μ$-involutions. We study Coxeter-theoretic properties of $μ$-involutions with results including a combinatorial description for their atoms, an exchange lemma, and transposition-like operators that characterize their Bruhat order.
